modifications: no free 3D model was found with the parts this topic binds (separate zones, moraines, meltwater, river): NASA 3D Resources, Smithsonian 3D, Poly Haven, Kenney/Quaternius, Wikimedia Commons searched 2026-10-16; marketplace models (RenderHub, CGTrader, Superhive) are not CC0/CC BY, Sketchfab downloads need a login; SRTM elevation tiles have no separate parts and the USGS download is login-gated

schematic Tien Shan valley glacier generated by the pipeline script (deterministic noise, seed 11): cirque, tributary glacier with medial moraine, accumulation zone (snow, flow banding) and ablation zone (bare ice) split exactly at the equilibrium line (dashed red line, altitude 1.27 units)
transverse/chevron crevasses and a bergschrund; supraglacial meltwater streams with moulins; an ice portal at the snout
proglacial lake dammed by the young terminal moraine; lateral moraines; an older, grassed terminal moraine marks the earlier extent; braided river on the outwash plain; spruce on the lower slopes
section view (client clips z > 0): long profile at z = 0 shows snow, four firn layers, ice (light to deep blue) and basal debris on bedrock; terrain block with horizontal strata
vertex colours (COLOR_0) instead of textures; gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation
